text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The semifinals are upon us! The
competition is so
fierce, I can feel the
pressure all the way from
here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
choice_data_list: I have full faith that you will win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale... At long last, the
semifinals are
about to begin!
